notes.zh-Hans:
使用 Xcode 27.3 Beta 和 iOS 27.3 SDK 重新构建。此版本是上一 TestFlight 版本的兼容性更新，应用功能和最低 iOS 版本不变。后续发布将要求最新已发布的 SDK，并在上传前检查应用包。

请测试配对、屏幕镜像、校准、简短任务以及返回应用。仍需要现有配套固件；本次不包含固件更新。实际手势精度及设备端到端行为仍需验证。
notes.en-US:
Rebuilt with Xcode 27.3 beta and the iOS 27.3 SDK. This is a compatibility rebuild of the previous TestFlight release; app features and minimum supported iOS version are unchanged. Future releases require the newest published SDK and verify the packaged app before upload.

Please check pairing, mirrored video, calibration, a short task and return to the app. Existing companion firmware remains required; this rebuild contains no firmware update. Physical gesture accuracy and end-to-end device behavior remain unverified.
